question.text: Which of these belong in a pull request that adds a login form?

meta.summary: A security review: tick what belongs in a pull request that adds a login form, then check and read why one does not belong.

text.text: A CSRF token on the form

why.text: Without one, another site can post the form for a logged-in user.

text.text: Logging the submitted password for debugging

why.text: Never: logs are read by many people and kept for a long time.

text.text: Serving the page over HTTPS only

why.text: Otherwise the password crosses the network in clear text.
